english.title: Personal licence holder fail to notify licensing authority of conviction / immigration penalty during application period
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an applicant for the grant of a personal licence under the Licensing Act 2003, without reasonable excuse, failed, as soon as reasonably practicable, to notify the licensing authority that you had been

(A)_[convicted on **(..SPECIFY DATE OF CONVICTION) by **(..SPECIFY THE COURT..) of a relevant offence, namely **(..SPECIFY THE OFFENCE..),]_
(B)_[convicted on **(..SPECIFY DATE OF CONVICTION) by **(..SPECIFY THE COURT..) of a [foreign offence, namely **(..SPECIFY THE OFFENCE..),]_
(C)_[required to pay an immigration penalty issued on **(..SPECIFY DATE OF PENALTY NOTICE..),]_

during the application period
